writing-for-agents.note: Adapted: unslop pass over the prose, sharpened rule that a description is a trigger not a summary, SKILL-MECHANICS rewritten for astack's harnesses and sibling-path reach, unslop pointer and encode-lessons pruning rule added.

unslop.note: Rules verbatim; rule numbers are stable ids other skills cite. Description shortened to a human-facing line; disable-model-invocation set, from which the installer generates the Codex policy.

principles.note: All 23 principle skills as plain files under one user-invoked index. Frontmatter removed, applicability retained in the bodies, links adapted to local files, and unavailable skill references removed. Headings use sentence case and duplicate applicability statements are removed. Adaptations put migration preconditions before the rule, bound root-cause fixes to the task's scope, preserve external-constraint explanations, clarify boundary guarantees, and consolidate the mechanism hierarchy. Autonomy follows the user's authorization and approval preferences; context guidance follows writing-for-agents. Other edits correct the assertion-pattern heading, group failing-test and fix commits into one verified unit, allow reuse of a concrete tool, and narrow attack-the-premise to actor imbalances without treating an even census as proof. Earlier astack-added completion tests and one-off reply notes are removed. Upstream examples for pure functions, idempotency, and the reader-load/context-window cross-reference are retained.

open-pr.note: Adapted under the global Pull Requests policy. Keeps narrow PRs, stack relationships, coherent commits, no-comments, technical-writing, unslop, title guidance, and default description sections. Cursor forge and deslop removed; Gitleaks hook install and T3 Code PR linking added.

review-pr.note: Based on the pinned upstream directory, preserving the two axes, twelve Fowler smells, reviewer briefs, and separate reports. Adapts invocation metadata, removes Matt-specific setup, prioritizes user requirements, reviews the requested diff, records the PR head, and links optional attributed posting through harden-pr's shared PR helper. Removes the old rubric and prompt builder.

technical-writing.note: Verbatim apart from a shorter description, the unslop pointer as a sibling link, and one pstack-specific formatting line removed.

no-comments.note: The Comment Sicko subagent is gone; its keep list and flag rules are the skill body, applied by the agent itself. The /how, /why, and /architect calls became read-the-history and sketch-the-shape instructions; principle references point at ../principles files.

harden-pr.license: MIT, kept in skills/harden-pr/LICENSE-pstack, LICENSE-mattpocock, and LICENSE-gstack
harden-pr.note: Adapted from the pinned gstack review directory. Retains core checks, specialist criteria, independent adversarial review, and outside structured review. Consolidates scope and dispatch, removes numerical scoring and aesthetic rules, and replaces gstack runtime dependencies. Adds astack PR posting, requested follow-through, and targeted mutation guidance. See upstream/review-adaptations.md.
